text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My father was a bartender who frequently practiced at home. Thus,
though I never imbibed, cocktails were an intimate presence in my life.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And my mother, much like ourselves,
was a warrior who staked her soul upon the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Racing was thus woven into the fabric of my youth.
The unrivaled 'speed' that brook no pursuit, the absolute 'strength' that subjugated races—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Time and again, those virtues struck chords deep within my soul,
naturally sculpting the dreams and passions I came to yearn for.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Be swift, be strong—that is the supreme aesthetic.
With those two tenets as my compass, I raced across the wilderness—until an epiphany struck me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I possessed no 'base' of my own...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...A standard cocktail generally adheres to three essential elements:
sweetness, sourness, and the foundational liquor known as the 'base.'

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A Balalaika takes vodka as its base, shaken with white curaçao
and lemon juice before being poured into a glass to find completion.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Replace the vodka base with brandy and it becomes a Sidecar; with gin, a White Lady;
with tequila, a Margarita—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: It is by its 'base' that fine nectar receives its name and attains perfection.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
In other words, no matter how vigorously one shakes the sweetness and sourness
of 'be swift' and 'be strong,' those alone will never bring it to completion.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I must determine the base of my very being.
What is it that I, as myself, wish to achieve...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Amidst those tribulations, my father taught me of a certain cocktail—

The memoir abruptly cut off there...
and in its place was an inserted note.
『Want to hear the rest? You know the bar.』

Translated, it read: “Seekest thou the continuation? Then to that bar.”
Setting aside why she went out of her way to write it in English—
choice_data_list: What she sought beyond speed and strength...

text_block_list.text:
My curiosity thoroughly piqued, I headed straight for
that bar and restaurant—presumably the place she meant.

text_block_list.name: Bartender
text_block_list.text: —A complimentary cocktail for you, courtesy of the house.

Upon arriving at the bar and restaurant, the bartender
presented me with a complimentary cocktail for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Bartender
text_block_list.text:
They requested that you take a sip.
...From a rather eccentric member of our staff.

It seems Tanino Gimlet set this whole thing up.
Perhaps this will reveal what follows in the memoir.

Deciding to comply, I took a tentative sip...
It was a cocktail characterized by its crisp, sharp edge. Yes—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: A Gimlet!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Heh heh! Welcome beneath the boughs of my World Tree.
I had foreseen that reading that would inevitably draw you here.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we return to the discourse?
Indeed, the revelation from my father was none other than that sacred cocktail—
Tanino Gimlet pointed toward the glass in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: To me, who could not yet drink, my father imparted its flavor through words.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“A Gimlet is an exquisite nectar that leaves a fierce, indelible impression
in an ephemeral instant, beckoning the soul to yearn for it.”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: And he spoke thus as well.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
“There is an aesthetic in shining on endlessly, and an aesthetic in shining for an instant to carve a deep scar.
An enduring glow garners affection, but it is only the ephemeral brilliance that scorches the heart.”

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...—Ephemeral brilliance that scorches the heart...?

text_block_list.name: Gimlet's Father
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. If you ask for my perspective... for someone as fierce and tempestuous as you,
the light you chase and yearn for is precisely that dazzling, resplendent radiance.

text_block_list.name: Young Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Fa... ther...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Nnngh! Ah, yes! That is precisely it, Father!
Can you hear this surging pulse within my breast, Father?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Wielding speed and strength, to blaze with blinding brilliance in a fleeting instant!
A myth etched upon the eyes, the mind, the heart, the past, and the future...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That is the very self I seek to become!
With the Gimlet, the raison d'être of 'Tanino Gimlet' begins!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I require nothing else!
A burning claw mark deeper than any abyss of imprisonment, I—I shall...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Inscribe it upon this world...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—...And thus, from that day forth,
I honed my strength and speed upon the foundation of that fleeting, blinding brilliance.

Tanino Gimlet flashed a fearless grin at my overwhelmed expression,
then produced a white envelope.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Come, behold the climax of the tale.

Opening the seal of the handed letter, inside was—
a note inscribed with “Mock Race Spectator Ticket.”

It appeared handmade, though spectator tickets weren't usually required.
Setting aside whether this was just part of her theatrical staging...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I shall contest the upcoming mock race.
...A race on the turf over 2,400 meters.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: A Trainer such as yourself should grasp the significance of this.

A 2,400-meter race held with barely any interval after a Mile race.
This means—

It demands the raw speed required for the NHK Mile Cup, alongside the comprehensive strength
needed to conquer the Japan Derby to decide the greatest of the generation—

It mirrors the increasingly talked-about campaign concept—challenging
from a Mile race to Classic distance: the 'MC Rotation'!
choice_data_list: You're aiming for the MC Rotation?!
You're aiming for the MC Rotation, aren't you?!

text_block_list.text:
Swift, and strong. Blazing with blinding brilliance in a fleeting instant.
It was a glory perfectly suited to the aesthetic she preached.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Upon enrolling, destiny brought me face-to-face with that path.
I was convinced. I alone was the vanguard destined to accomplish it first!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And yet—... Heh.
In the previous Mile race, fortune refused to smile upon me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Foolishness. 'What-ifs' are forbidden in true contest.
However—yes. This is a manuscript of potential.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Whether I possess the potential to achieve the MC Rotation in the Twinkle Series,
or if I do not. —You wish to know the answer, do you not?
When I nodded fervently, Tanino Gimlet smiled in satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Then await another barspoon of gin...!
